thesis: The speakers argue that while the public narrative of AI focuses on training smarter models, the critical and increasingly complex challenge is the infrastructure required to run them efficiently. They contend that inference has evolved from a straightforward task into a systems problem involving chaotic, unpredictable requests that require new hardware optimization and open-source stewardship to support the next generation of AI agents.
